scope: Clarify the ordered task contract and observable completion conditions for the six formal RMBench tasks without exposing seeds, world coordinates, robot-arm assignments, low-level motion commands, or hidden task answers.
design_rules: Preserve the task objective, object relationships, and stage order defined by the original RMBench instruction and implementation.
State what must be identified at the start, which identities must remain continuous, and the observable final state.
Do not include environment seeds, fixed world coordinates, task-specific arm assignments, low-level motion commands, or hidden task answers.
Apply the same instruction text to every evaluated method in this instruction condition.
Report this clarified-instruction condition separately from vanilla RMBench.

rearrange_blocks.rationale: Make the initial block identities, empty mat, required stage order, and final placement explicit.

swap_blocks.rationale: Make the initial block-to-tray identities, temporary-buffer role, capacity constraint, and button timing explicit.

press_button.rationale: Make the number-to-button mapping, distinct press counting, stage order, and confirmation condition explicit.

place_block_mat.rationale: Make left-to-right processing, the per-block visit to the green mat, original-mat identity, and final state explicit.

put_back_block.rationale: Make the original mat identity, center-button-return stage order, and final release condition explicit.

cover_blocks.rationale: Make the two ordered phases, spatial-to-color identity tracking, lid return locations, and final uncovered state explicit.
